shortAnswer: Prabin Parajuli is a Cloud Infrastructure / AWS / Cloud DX Engineer based in Ichikawa, Chiba, in the Tokyo area of Japan. He works on AWS operations, IAM and security, monitoring, deployment reliability and file-server migration (FSx, Robocopy) at WITS Corp (Wistron), with a full-stack background in React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js.

faq.a: Prabin Parajuli is a Cloud Infrastructure / AWS / Cloud DX Engineer based in Ichikawa, Chiba, in the Tokyo area of Japan. He is a Nepali engineer working at WITS Corp (Wistron) on AWS operations, IAM and security, monitoring and file-server migration, and he holds a BSc in Computing from London Metropolitan University.
He lives in Ichikawa, Chiba, Japan, within the greater Tokyo area, and is work-ready in Japan. He is open to cloud infrastructure and AWS engineering roles across the country.

He runs and improves cloud infrastructure on AWS: day-to-day operations, IAM and security, monitoring and observability, deployment reliability, and migration work including AWS FSx and Robocopy file-server moves. He also builds full-stack software with React, Next.js, TypeScript and Node.js.

He built DO101 (do101.online), a free browser-based tools platform with 28 tools, plus this portfolio at pprabin.com.np which also runs a spaced-repetition Japanese flashcards app and a Gemini-backed voice transcriber. Earlier client work includes Mantra Mountain, Travel Himalayan and Singapore Handpans.

faq.q: What certifications does Prabin Parajuli have?
faq.a: He is an AWS Academy Graduate in Cloud Foundations and has completed 50+ LinkedIn Learning, Coursera and Microsoft courses spanning cloud, networking and Linux, programming foundations, Java, web development and generative AI. Every certificate is viewable on his portfolio.

faq.q: What languages does Prabin Parajuli speak?
faq.a: English, Nepali and Japanese. He works daily in a Japanese-language IT environment and is studying for JLPT N2.

faq.q: Is Prabin Parajuli available for hire?
faq.a: Yes. He is open to Cloud Infrastructure, AWS and Cloud DX roles in Japan, as well as positions blending cloud operations with software development. He can be reached at prabin.parajuli.jp@gmail.com.
